name: Sky Cards
tagline: claude-motion-design's SaaS launch look: off-white ground, white rounded cards, one sky accent.

motion.direction: SaaS launch film on a light ground. Headlines rise word by word under a mask (55 ms per word), mixed case, weight 700, one line each (2–5 words), one accent word in `ter`; exits are 0.3 s ease-in dives. Hook in the first 2 s as a question. A chain of steps, each 2–4 s, each `chip` or `chapterCard` producing what the next uses. Proof with a real number: `counter`s ticking up with a label. Straight `imageCard`s (tilt 0) as white cards. Something new every 2–4 s; every element readable for at least 1.5 s; never more than one thing moving at once. No stamps, no slams, no patterns, no glow, no emoji, no invented metrics.
